summary: WEC Energy Group filed an 8-K on November 6, 2026, covering Regulation FD disclosure, Other Events, and exhibits. Representatives will meet investors using slides furnished as Exhibit 99.1. Under Item 8.01, the Public Service Commission of Wisconsin on November 5, 2026 approved rate changes in April 2026 rate cases filed by subsidiaries Wisconsin Electric Power Company, Wisconsin Gas LLC, and Wisconsin Public Service Corporation; details appear on slide 9. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed. Routine utility ratemaking disclosure; no risk-arb angle.
